TABLE.NAME: ednote
TABLE.COMMENT: A teacher-only note shown inline on the course page, like a label that students cannot see. Which users can see it is decided entirely by the mod/ednote:view capability - see the comment in db/access.php.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: The note body. For a standalone note this is the whole story. For a note carrying a presetid it is only a fallback snapshot, used when mod_edpreset is absent or the preset has been deleted - the live text is read from edpreset_item.teacherguidance on every render.

FIELD.NAME: presetid
FIELD.COMMENT: edpreset_item.id this note shows the guidance for, or 0 for a standalone note. Not a foreign key: mod_edpreset is an optional dependency and its tables may not exist. Also the key the 'always hide this guidance' scope is stored against, which is why it must survive a course backup.
